mapper.select:
select g.id, g.group_name, g.enabled, g.create_time, g.update_time, (select count(*) from tg_telethon_account a where a.group_id = g.id and (a.is_deleted = 0 or a.is_deleted is null)) as account_count, (select count(*) from tg_telethon_account a where a.group_id = g.id and (a.is_deleted = 0 or a.is_deleted is null) and a.status = 'online') as online_count, (select count(*) from tg_telethon_account a where a.group_id = g.id and (a.is_deleted = 0 or a.is_deleted is null) and a.is_restricted = 1) as restricted_count, (select count(*) from tg_telethon_account a where a.group_id = g.id and (a.is_deleted = 0 or a.is_deleted is null) and a.is_frozen = 1) as frozen_count from tg_account_group g
AND g.group_name like concat('%', #{groupName}, '%')
AND g.enabled = #{enabled}
order by g.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into tg_account_group (group_name, enabled, create_time) values (#{groupName}, #{enabled}, now())
